title: माध्यमिक तहमा कथा शिक्षण विधि र प्रयोगको अवस्था {Story teaching method in secondary level and situation of application}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा कीर्तिपुर नगरपालिकाभित्रका आदिनाथ मा. वि., वैष्णवी मा. वि., विश्व राष्ट्रिय मा. वि., कीर्तिपुर मा. वि. र मङ्गल मा. वि. का कक्षा नौ मा अध्यापनरत शिक्षकहरूको कथा शिक्षणका सम्बन्धमा अन्तरक्रिया सहित कथा शिक्षणका विधि र तिनको प्रयोगको अवस्था विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । कीर्तिपुर नगरपालिकाका सामुदायिक विद्यालयहरूमा कथा शिक्षण गर्दा पठनबोध विधिअन्तर्गत अधिकांश शिक्षकहरूले पाठको विषयवस्तु र घटनाबोधमा मात्र विद्यार्थीलाई सीमित गराएको देखियो। कथा शिक्षण गर्दा प्रयोग गरिने छलपफ्लरप्रश्नोत्तर विधिमा अधिकांश शिक्षकले विद्यार्थी र शिक्षक बीचमा सीमित बनाई केवल पाठ्यपुस्तकको अभ्यासकेन्द्रित प्रश्नोत्तर गराएको पाइयो। कथा शिक्षणका त्रफ्ममा अधिकांश शिक्षकहरूले एकोहोरो व्याख्यान गरेको पाइयो। कीर्तिपुरका सामुदाियक विद्यालयमा कथा शिक्षण गर्दा अधिकांश शिक्षकहरूले कथाको सारांश, पात्र र मूलभावमा सीमित समीक्षा गराएको पाइयो।
american_english: In the present study, incorporating interactions regarding story teaching with teachers instructing grade nine at Adinath Secondary School, Vaishnavi Secondary School, Bishwa Rashtriya Secondary School, Kirtipur Secondary School, and Mangal Secondary School within Kirtipur Municipality, story teaching methods and the status of their implementation are analyzed. When teaching stories in community schools of Kirtipur Municipality, under the reading comprehension method, the majority of teachers were observed to limit students solely to the subject matter and event comprehension of the text. In the discussion/question-and-answer method utilized during story instruction, most teachers were found to restrict it between student and teacher, conducting question-and-answer sessions focused merely on textbook exercises. In the course of story instruction, most teachers were found to rely on one-way lectures. When teaching stories in the community schools of Kirtipur, the majority of teachers were found to conduct reviews confined strictly to the summary, characters, and core theme of the story.

informal_english: In the present study, based on chats regarding story teaching with teachers instructing grade nine at Adinath Secondary School, Vaishnavi Secondary School, Bishwa Rashtriya Secondary School, Kirtipur Secondary School, and Mangal Secondary School within Kirtipur Municipality, story teaching methods and how they're actually used are analyzed. When teaching stories in community schools of Kirtipur Municipality, under the reading comprehension method, most teachers were observed to limit students solely to the subject matter and event comprehension of the text. In the discussion/question-and-answer method used during story instruction, most teachers were found to keep things strictly between student and teacher, conducting question-and-answer sessions focused merely on textbook exercises. In the course of story instruction, most teachers were found to basically rely on one-way lectures. When teaching stories in Kirtipur's community schools, most teachers were found to conduct reviews confined strictly to the summary, characters, and core theme of the story.
